modules.name: GridDrums
modules.description: Six-track, sixteen-step trigger sequencer played from a monome grid (via serialosc) or the on-screen grid, with 16 pattern slots that change at the next bar

modules.name: LessConcepts
modules.description: Cellular-automaton melody sequencer for two voices, after the norns script less concepts by dan derks and linus schrab: monome grid control, 16 snapshots with cycling, CV and gate outputs

modules.name: GridKeys
modules.description: Push-style note keyboard on a monome grid: notes from the bottom-left, the same note in several places, In Key or Chromatic, 26 scales, chord pads (shape, extensions, inversions, voicing), a 10-slot chord memory playable by CV, strum, latch, poly and mono outputs

modules.name: GridMutes
modules.description: 18-channel clocked performance mutes for audio, CV or triggers, played from a monome grid: cue and lock, solo, A/B toggle pairs, stereo pairs, invert, 16 scenes with CV select, click-free fades, signal activity on the grid, submix of unpatched channels
